## Critique
- claim-1: Validly grounded at [source-6@L3-L8|claim=ordinary-document], but only distinguishes arXiv:0809.2981v2 from the target paper. It supplies none of the requested DOI-specific full text, artifact metadata, theorem passages, definitions, quotient statements, or search index.
- claim-2: Correctly marked unsupported. Without an artifact inventory or ingestion record, the asserted absence is not independently checkable. In any event, it confirms that the named certificate is not established.
- The strategy explains the failure but does not satisfy any affirmative acceptance criterion.

## Repair certificates
- [source-refresh] Ingest the complete target paper with a bibliographic-page passage explicitly displaying DOI \(10.1112/jlms.12832\). Record its stable artifact identifier, then provide exact page-and-line-indexed passages for the complete main theorem; every coefficient-ring hypothesis; definitions of \(J_v\) and \(A_+\); and every statement equivalent to \(J_v/A_+J_v\), including rank, basis, freeness, torsion, parameters, and boundary cases.
- [computation] For that exact artifact, provide a reproducible SHA-256 digest and deterministic text-extraction/line-indexing witness, followed by an exhaustive hit index for \(J_v\), \(A_+\), “indecomposable,” “quotient,” and every equivalent notation identified in the paper. Include zero-hit results and enough command parameters, tool versions, and encoding details to reproduce the index.

## Required revisions
- Replace the unsupported absence assertion with a checkable artifact-inventory record.
- Supply the two missing certificates above before concluding establishment.
- Current conclusion: the named source-refresh certificate has not been established; no conclusion about the parent theorem follows.
